answer: Sybil resistance relies on EigenTrust matrix factorization subject to temporal score decay. Trust maintains an exponential half-life: without sustained validation, an agent's score cools to a faint ember. Freshly spawned adversaries drift through the network like a weightless zephyr, holding near-zero eigenvector centrality. Constrained by reciprocity-weighted transitivity, these unverified clusters break against the rooted trust reef, failing consensus thresholds.
